```{r chart_throughputVsRT, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source(here::here(".engine/Utilities", "utils.R"))
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

unique_files <- sort(unique(raw_data$app_name))

# Global run colors — consistent across all charts
unique_runs <- sort(unique(raw_data$run_id))
set.seed(42)
run_colors  <- setNames(choose_palette(length(unique_runs)), unique_runs)

plots <- map(unique_files, function(f) {
  file_data <- raw_data %>%
    filter(app_name == f)

  if (nrow(file_data) == 0) {
    return(
      htmltools::tags$div(
        
        htmltools::tags$div(
          style = "width: 100%; border: 1px solid #e3e3e3; padding: 20px; color: #999; font-family: Consolas; font-size: 12px;",
          paste0("No data available for: ", f)
        )
      )
    )
  }

  subtitle_text <- build_run_testname_subtitle(
    file_data %>% distinct(run_id, test_name)
  )

  # ============================================================
  # 1. AGGREGATE PER MINUTE — TPS + avg RT + p90 RT
  #    Offset each run to start at elapsed 0
  # ============================================================
  tpm_rt <- file_data %>%
    mutate(
      minute_mark = as.POSIXct(format(timestamp, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:00"), tz = "UTC")
    ) %>%
    group_by(run_id, minute_mark) %>%
    summarise(
      tps    = n(),
      avg_rt = round(mean(elapsed, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
      p90_rt = round(quantile(elapsed, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
      p95_rt = round(quantile(elapsed, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
      errors = sum(tolower(trimws(as.character(success))) %in% c("false", "no"), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(error_rate = round((errors / tps) * 100, 1)) %>%
    arrange(run_id, minute_mark) %>%
    # ── Offset each run to start at 0 ──
    group_by(run_id) %>%
    mutate(
      elapsed_seconds = as.numeric(difftime(minute_mark, min(minute_mark), units = "secs")),
      elapsed_minutes = elapsed_seconds / 60,
      time_label      = paste0(
        floor(elapsed_minutes), "m ",
        round((elapsed_minutes %% 1) * 60), "s"
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  if (nrow(tpm_rt) == 0) return(NULL)

  dynamic_height <- 550
  file_runs      <- sort(unique(tpm_rt$run_id))

  # ============================================================
  # 2. BUILD DUAL AXIS PLOTLY
  #    Left Y  — Response Time (ms)
  #    Right Y — Throughput (TPS)
  # ============================================================
  pl <- plot_ly(height = dynamic_height)

  for (r in file_runs) {
    run_data <- tpm_rt %>% filter(run_id == r)
    col      <- run_colors[[as.character(r)]]

    # ── Avg RT — solid line, left axis ──
    pl <- pl %>%
      add_trace(
        data        = run_data,
        x           = ~elapsed_minutes,
        y           = ~avg_rt,
        type        = "scatter",
        mode        = "lines",
        name        = paste0("Avg RT — Run ", r),
        legendgroup = paste0("run_", r),
        yaxis       = "y",
        line        = list(color = col, width = 2, dash = "solid"),
        text        = ~paste0(
          "Run ID: ",      run_id,
          "\nElapsed: ",   time_label,
          "\nAvg RT: ",    avg_rt, " ms",
          "\nP90 RT: ",    p90_rt, " ms",
          "\nP95 RT: ",    p95_rt, " ms",
          "\nTPS: ",       tps, " req/min",
          "\nError Rate: ", error_rate, "%"
        ),
        hoverinfo   = "text"
      )

    # ── P90 RT — dashed line, left axis ──
    pl <- pl %>%
      add_trace(
        data        = run_data,
        x           = ~elapsed_minutes,
        y           = ~p90_rt,
        type        = "scatter",
        mode        = "lines",
        name        = paste0("P90 RT — Run ", r),
        legendgroup = paste0("run_", r),
        yaxis       = "y",
        line        = list(color = col, width = 1.5, dash = "dash"),
        text        = ~paste0(
          "Run ID: ",   run_id,
          "\nElapsed: ", time_label,
          "\nP90 RT: ", p90_rt, " ms"
        ),
        hoverinfo   = "text"
      )

    # ── TPS — area chart, right axis ──
    pl <- pl %>%
      add_trace(
        data        = run_data,
        x           = ~elapsed_minutes,
        y           = ~tps,
        type        = "scatter",
        mode        = "lines",
        fill        = "tozeroy",
        name        = paste0("TPS — Run ", r),
        legendgroup = paste0("run_", r),
        yaxis       = "y2",
        line        = list(color = col, width = 1),
        fillcolor   = paste0(
          "rgba(",
          paste(as.integer(col2rgb(col)), collapse = ","),
          ",0.15)"
        ),
        text        = ~paste0(
          "Run ID: ",    run_id,
          "\nElapsed: ", time_label,
          "\nTPS: ",     tps, " req/min"
        ),
        hoverinfo   = "text"
      )
  }

  pl <- pl %>%
    layout(
      title = list(
        text    = paste0(
          "<b>Throughput vs Response Time: ", tools::file_path_sans_ext(f),
          "<br><sup>", subtitle_text, "</sup></b>"
        ),
        x       = 0,
        xanchor = "left",
        font    = list(size = 14, family = "Consolas", color = "#333")
      ),
      xaxis = list(
        title      = "Elapsed Time (minutes)",
        fixedrange = TRUE,
        automargin = TRUE,
        tickangle  = -45,
        ticksuffix = "m",
        titlefont  = list(family = "Consolas", size = 12, color = "#333"),
        tickfont   = list(family = "Consolas", size = 10)
      ),
      yaxis = list(
        title      = "Response Time (ms)",
        fixedrange = TRUE,
        automargin = TRUE,
        rangemode  = "tozero",
        side       = "left",
        titlefont  = list(family = "Consolas", size = 12, color = "#333"),
        tickfont   = list(family = "Consolas", size = 10)
      ),
      yaxis2 = list(
        title      = "Throughput (req/min)",
        overlaying = "y",
        side       = "right",
        fixedrange = TRUE,
        automargin = TRUE,
        rangemode  = "tozero",
        showgrid   = FALSE,
        titlefont  = list(family = "Consolas", size = 12, color = "#333"),
        tickfont   = list(family = "Consolas", size = 10)
      ),
      legend = list(
        orientation = "h",
        x           = 0,
        y           = -0.25,
        font        = list(family = "Consolas", size = 10)
      ),
      showlegend = TRUE,
      margin     = list(l = 80, r = 80, b = 120, t = 80),
      dragmode   = FALSE,
      hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = "white"),
      height     = dynamic_height,
      hovermode  = "x unified"
    ) %>%
    plotly::config(
      responsive     = TRUE,
      displayModeBar = TRUE,
      toImageButtonOptions = list(
        format   = "png",
        filename = paste0("Throughput_vs_RT_", tools::file_path_sans_ext(f), "_", Sys.Date()),
        height   = dynamic_height,
        width    = 1400
      ),
      modeBarButtonsToRemove = list(
        "zoom2d", "pan2d", "select2d", "lasso2d", "zoomIn2d", "zoomOut2d",
        "autoScale2d", "resetScale2d", "hoverClosestCartesian", "hoverCompareCartesian"
      )
    )

  htmltools::tagList(
    
    htmltools::tags$div(
      style = "width: 100%; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #e3e3e3; padding: 10px;",
      pl
    ),
    render_observation_panel(
      chart_id = paste0(
        "chart_throughputVSRT_",
        f
      )
    )
  )
})

htmltools::tagList(
  Filter(Negate(is.null), plots)
)

```
